entities.summary: Christopher Michael Devenski, also known as "Devo", is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Pittsburgh Pirates organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Houston Astros, Arizona Diamondbacks, Philadelphia Phillies, Los Angeles Angels, Tampa Bay Rays, and New York Mets. He made his MLB debut in 2016.
